newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Quake causes minor damage in southern Albania.
newsitem.headline: Quake causes minor damage in southern Albania.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 4.3 on the Richter scale hit southern Albania on Sunday causing minor damage to homes but no casualties, the Albanian Seismological Institute said on Monday.
Institute head Betim Muco told television the tremor's epicentre was in the Berat-Gramsh area, 100 km south of Tirana.
It struck at 1311 local time (1211 GMT) on Sunday and was followed by an aftershock seven hours later.
"It caused slight damage in Berat to old homes but was not a cause for concern," Muco said.
Radio Tirana said the earthquake had shaken scores of homes in the Berat district, damaging the walls of taller buildings.
